blocks: Microfreak/UG/10 Keyboard/04 Octave Buttons — the buttons shift the keys up to three octaves either way, and the keys reach eight octaves in all.

MicroFreak user manual 1.0, section 6.1, The oscillator as a sound generator — gives the range the shifted keys reach as C−1 to C7 in Arturia's names, MIDI 12 to 108. The lowest key at -3 is C−1, the highest key at +3 is C7, and octave 0 sits three octaves in from each end, at C2 to C4 in Arturia's names.
